title: Zohocorp Manageengine DDI Central build below 6500 are affected by a authenticated PowerShell command injection…
description: ManageEngine DDI Central builds below 6500 contain an authenticated PowerShell command injection vulnerability in the Telnet connectivity feature. This flaw allows attackers with valid credentials to execute arbitrary commands on managed Windows nodes by leveraging specially crafted IPv6 scope identifiers. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 9.1, indicating critical impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
